adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-event deletion logic is now inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (after changing `.find` to `.filter`). That means if there are multiple `_calendar` references on the booking, the recurring delete block will execute once per reference, but inside it still iterates over *all* calendar credentials and all `updatedBookings`, issuing `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` each time—leading to duplicated deletes. Additionally, within that block it still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, so only the first calendar reference per updated booking is deleted; any additional calendar refs (e.g., for other destination calendars/co-host calendars) would be skipped.
